verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote as the clear focal point at a readable size, but the oversized quote mark leaves a dead gap above the text, the logo sits jammed under the last line, and the attribution is unreadably small and pushed against the bottom edge. B shrinks the quote to small type that runs nearly to the right edge, so the logo block now outweighs the message. Its attribution is also illegible and stranded far below everything else above a large empty bottom area.
